description: This file provides utility classes, functions, and mock implementations for testing URLRequest components in the Chromium networking codebase. It includes classes for creating test URLRequest contexts, delegates, network delegates, and interceptors, as well as related helper functions.

classes.name: TestURLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Provides a dummy URLRequestContext for testing, associated with a specific task runner.

classes.name: TestDelegate
classes.description: Implements URLRequest::Delegate for testing, capturing request events and states.

classes.name: TestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Mocks network delegate behavior for testing network request handling.

classes.name: FilteringTestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Extends TestNetworkDelegate with cookie filtering capabilities.

classes.name: HttpTestServer
classes.description: A simple embedded test server with default handlers for testing HTTP requests.

classes.name: TestScopedURLInterceptor
classes.description: Sets up a temporary URLRequestInterceptor for intercepting specific URL requests during tests.

methods.name: CreateTestURLRequestContextBuilder
methods.description: Creates and configures a URLRequestContextBuilder for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext associated with the getter.

methods.name: GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner associated with the context getter.

methods.name: TestURLRequestContextGetter
methods.description: Constructor for creating a context getter with a task runner and optional pre-initialized context.

methods.name: NotifyContextShuttingDown
methods.description: Signals that the context is shutting down.

methods.name: TestDelegate
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and methods for controlling and querying request events.

methods.name: RunUntilComplete
methods.description: Runs the message loop until the request completes.

methods.name: RunUntilAuthRequired
methods.description: Runs until an authentication challenge occurs.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Handles the OnConnected event for a URLRequest.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a response.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.
